Create a correlation plot (Pearson correlation) between samples using methylation levels. Provide the plot and explain what it shows.

# Make sure methylation_fraction exists in every sample
SRR11647652 <- SRR11647652 %>%
  mutate(methylation_fraction = methylation_percent / 100)

SRR11647653 <- SRR11647653 %>%
  mutate(methylation_fraction = methylation_percent / 100)

SRR11647662 <- SRR11647662 %>%
  mutate(methylation_fraction = methylation_percent / 100)

SRR11647663 <- SRR11647663 %>%
  mutate(methylation_fraction = methylation_percent / 100)


#Make sure all samples are aligned by genomic position:

merged <- SRR11647652 %>%
  dplyr::select(chr, start, methylation_fraction) %>%
  dplyr::rename(SRR11647652 = methylation_fraction) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    SRR11647653 %>%
      dplyr::select(chr, start, methylation_fraction) %>%
      dplyr::rename(SRR11647653 = methylation_fraction),
    by = c("chr", "start")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    SRR11647662 %>%
      dplyr::select(chr, start, methylation_fraction) %>%
      dplyr::rename(SRR11647662 = methylation_fraction),
    by = c("chr", "start")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    SRR11647663 %>%
      dplyr::select(chr, start, methylation_fraction) %>%
      dplyr::rename(SRR11647663 = methylation_fraction),
    by = c("chr", "start")
  )

#Compute Pearson correlation matrix
cor_matrix <- cor(merged[, -c(1,2)], method = "pearson", use = "complete.obs")

#Plot correlation heatmap
library(pheatmap)

annotation <- data.frame(
  Type = c("Tumor", "Tumor", "Non_tumor", "Non_tumor")
)

rownames(annotation) <- c("SRR11647652", "SRR11647653", 
                         "SRR11647662", "SRR11647663")

ann_colors <- list(
  Type = c(
    Tumor = "#00BFC4",
    Non_tumor = "#F8766D"
  )
)

pheatmap(cor_matrix,
         display_numbers = TRUE,
         main = "Pearson Correlation of Methylation Levels",
         annotation_col = annotation,
         annotation_row = annotation,
         annotation_colors = ann_colors)
# Merge methylation fraction and coverage from all samples
merged_10x_2samples <- SRR11647652 %>%
  dplyr::select(chr, start, methylation_fraction, coverage) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    SRR11647652 = methylation_fraction,
    cov_52 = coverage
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    SRR11647653 %>%
      dplyr::select(chr, start, methylation_fraction, coverage) %>%
      dplyr::rename(
        SRR11647653 = methylation_fraction,
        cov_53 = coverage
      ),
    by = c("chr", "start")
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    SRR11647662 %>%
      dplyr::select(chr, start, methylation_fraction, coverage) %>%
      dplyr::rename(
        SRR11647662 = methylation_fraction,
        cov_62 = coverage
      ),
    by = c("chr", "start")
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    SRR11647663 %>%
      dplyr::select(chr, start, methylation_fraction, coverage) %>%
      dplyr::rename(
        SRR11647663 = methylation_fraction,
        cov_63 = coverage
      ),
    by = c("chr", "start")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    samples_10x = rowSums(
      dplyr::select(., cov_52, cov_53, cov_62, cov_63) >= 10,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(samples_10x >= 2)

Rerun PCA with different filtering (≥5x, ≥15x, ≥20x coverage). How does filtering affect sample clustering? Create a comparison figure and explain it.

run_pca_filter <- function(cov_threshold) {
  
  f52 <- SRR11647652 %>% filter(coverage >= cov_threshold)
  f53 <- SRR11647653 %>% filter(coverage >= cov_threshold)
  f62 <- SRR11647662 %>% filter(coverage >= cov_threshold)
  f63 <- SRR11647663 %>% filter(coverage >= cov_threshold)
  
  m52 <- f52 %>% mutate(site = paste(chr, start, end),
                       SRR11647652 = methylation_percent)
  m53 <- f53 %>% mutate(site = paste(chr, start, end),
                       SRR11647653 = methylation_percent)
  m62 <- f62 %>% mutate(site = paste(chr, start, end),
                       SRR11647662 = methylation_percent)
  m63 <- f63 %>% mutate(site = paste(chr, start, end),
                       SRR11647663 = methylation_percent)
  
  mat <- m52 %>%
    select(site, SRR11647652) %>%
    inner_join(m53 %>% select(site, SRR11647653), by="site") %>%
    inner_join(m62 %>% select(site, SRR11647662), by="site") %>%
    inner_join(m63 %>% select(site, SRR11647663), by="site")
  
  mat <- mat %>% select(-site) %>% as.matrix()
  rownames(mat) <- m52$site[match(rownames(mat), m52$site)]
  
  mat <- mat[apply(mat, 1, var) != 0, ]
  
  pca <- prcomp(t(mat), scale. = TRUE)
  
  df <- as.data.frame(pca$x)
  df$sample <- c("SRR11647652","SRR11647653","SRR11647662","SRR11647663")
  df$Type <- c("non_tumor","non_tumor","tumor","tumor")
  df$filter <- paste0("≥", cov_threshold, "x")
  
  return(df)
}
pca5  <- run_pca_filter(5)
pca15 <- run_pca_filter(15)
pca20 <- run_pca_filter(20)

all_pca <- bind_rows(pca5, pca15, pca20)
all_pca$filter <- factor(all_pca$filter, 
                         levels = c("≥5x", "≥15x", "≥20x"))
ggplot(all_pca, aes(PC1, PC2, color = Type, label = sample)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~filter) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("non_tumor"="#F8766D","tumor"="#00BFC4")) +
  labs(title = "PCA under Different Coverage Filters",
       x = "PC1",
       y = "PC2") +
  theme(
    panel.spacing = unit(0.5, "cm")   # 👈 spacing between panels
  )

coverage_thresholds <- coverage_long %>%
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  summarise(
    `>=1x`  = sum(coverage >= 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    `>=5x`  = sum(coverage >= 5, na.rm = TRUE),
    `>=15x` = sum(coverage >= 15, na.rm = TRUE),
    `>=20x` = sum(coverage >= 20, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(">="),
    names_to = "Coverage_threshold",
    values_to = "Number_of_CpGs"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Coverage_threshold = factor(
      Coverage_threshold,
      levels = c(">=1x", ">=5x", ">=15x", ">=20x")
    )
  )

ggplot(
  coverage_thresholds,
  aes(
    x = Coverage_threshold,
    y = Number_of_CpGs,
    fill = Coverage_threshold
  )
) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  facet_wrap(~ sample_id, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Number of CpGs Passing Coverage Thresholds per Sample",
    x = "Coverage threshold",
    y = "Number of CpGs",
    fill = "Coverage threshold"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

  mutate(cpg_id = paste(chr, start, end, sep = "_"))

SRR11647663 <- SRR11647663 %>%
  mutate(cpg_id = paste(chr, start, end, sep = "_"))

# Build methylation table using methylation fraction
methylation_dt <- SRR11647652 %>%
  select(cpg_id, chr, position = start, SRR11647652 = methylation_fraction) %>%
  inner_join(
    SRR11647653 %>% select(cpg_id, SRR11647653 = methylation_fraction),
    by = "cpg_id"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    SRR11647662 %>% select(cpg_id, SRR11647662 = methylation_fraction),
    by = "cpg_id"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    SRR11647663 %>% select(cpg_id, SRR11647663 = methylation_fraction),
    by = "cpg_id"
  )

# Build coverage table using coverage
coverage_dt <- SRR11647652 %>%
  select(cpg_id, chr, position = start, SRR11647652 = coverage) %>%
  inner_join(
    SRR11647653 %>% select(cpg_id, SRR11647653 = coverage),
    by = "cpg_id"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    SRR11647662 %>% select(cpg_id, SRR11647662 = coverage),
    by = "cpg_id"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    SRR11647663 %>% select(cpg_id, SRR11647663 = coverage),
    by = "cpg_id"
  )

# Convert to data.table
setDT(methylation_dt)
setDT(coverage_dt)
# Create BSseq object
library(pacman)
sample_cols <- names(methylation_dt)[!names(methylation_dt) %in% c("cpg_id", "chr", "position")]

chr <- methylation_dt$chr
pos <- methylation_dt$position

M_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(methylation_dt), ncol = length(sample_cols))
Cov_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(methylation_dt), ncol = length(sample_cols))

  for(i in 1:length(sample_cols)) {
    sample <- sample_cols[i]
    
    meth <- methylation_dt[[sample]]
    cov <- coverage_dt[[sample]]
    
    M_matrix[, i] <- round(meth * cov, 0)
    Cov_matrix[, i] <- cov
    
    M_matrix[is.na(M_matrix[, i]), i] <- 0
    Cov_matrix[is.na(Cov_matrix[, i]), i] <- 0
  }

colnames(M_matrix) <- sample_cols
colnames(Cov_matrix) <- sample_cols

library(bsseq)
BS <- BSseq(chr = chr,
            pos = pos,
            M = M_matrix,
            Cov = Cov_matrix,
            sampleNames = sample_cols)

pData(BS) <- sample_info
rownames(pData(BS)) <- sample_info$sample_id
saveRDS(BS, "bsseq_object.RDS")

# Define comparison
group1_samples <- c("SRR11647652", "SRR11647653")  # healthy / normal
group2_samples <- c("SRR11647662", "SRR11647663")  # tumor

selected_samples <- c(group1_samples, group2_samples)

# Check that samples are present
selected_samples %in% sampleNames(BS)
[1] TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE
# Filtering BS data. What can happen if we skip this? 

cov_matrix <- getCoverage(BS)
samples_covered <- rowSums(
  cov_matrix[, selected_samples] >= 10,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

keep_cpgs <- samples_covered == length(selected_samples)

BS_filtered <- BS[keep_cpgs]
saveRDS(BS_filtered, "BS_filtered.RDS")

library(DSS)
# run the test
dmlTest <- DMLtest(BS_filtered, 
                  group1 = group1_samples,
                  group2 = group2_samples,
                  ncores = 1, 
                  smoothing = FALSE)

# Convert DSS result to data.table

# Check column names

# Thresholds
fdr_cutoff <- 0.05
delta_cutoff <- 0.10

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# List 1: DMCs using statistical significance only
# adjusted p-value / FDR threshold
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dmcs_fdr_only <- dml_dt[
  fdr < fdr_cutoff
]

# Add direction column
dmcs_fdr_only[, direction := ifelse(
  diff > 0,
  "higher_in_healthy",
  "higher_in_tumor"
)]

# Save as RDS and CSV
saveRDS(dmcs_fdr_only, "DMCs_FDR_only.RDS")
fwrite(dmcs_fdr_only, "DMCs_FDR_only.csv")


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# List 2: DMCs using FDR + methylation difference threshold
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dmcs_fdr_delta <- dml_dt[
  fdr < fdr_cutoff & abs(diff) >= delta_cutoff
]

# Add direction column
dmcs_fdr_delta[, direction := ifelse(
  diff > 0,
  "higher_in_healthy",
  "higher_in_tumor"
)]

# Save as RDS and CSV
saveRDS(dmcs_fdr_delta, "DMCs_FDR_delta.RDS")
fwrite(dmcs_fdr_delta, "DMCs_FDR_delta.csv")
library(data.table)

# diff = healthy - tumor
# diff < 0 means hypermethylated in tumor
# diff > 0 means hypomethylated in tumor

    "Total significant DMCs",
    "Hypermethylated DMCs in tumor",

    sum(dmcs_fdr_only$diff < 0),
    sum(dmcs_fdr_only$diff > 0)

    nrow(dmcs_fdr_delta),
    sum(dmcs_fdr_delta$diff < 0),

  )
)

Using a chromosome you like (or several), perform DMC calling using an R package you like (you can use DSS that we used) and using the Wilcoxon test. Create Venn diagram of overlap between the methods. Table comparing the number of DMCs, mean effect size. Which method is more conservative? Why?

# ============================================================
# DSS DMCs
# ============================================================

# DSS result already contains chr20 only in your dataset
dss_results <- copy(dml_dt)

# Create CpG ID
dss_results[, cpg_id := paste(chr, pos, sep = "_")]

# DSS diff direction:
# group1 = healthy, group2 = tumor
# diff = healthy - tumor
# diff < 0 means hypermethylated in tumor
# diff > 0 means hypomethylated in tumor

dss_dmcs <- dss_results[
  fdr < fdr_cutoff & abs(diff) >= delta_cutoff
]

dss_dmcs[, method := "DSS"]

# Save DSS DMCs
fwrite(dss_dmcs, "chr20_DSS_DMCs.csv")
saveRDS(dss_dmcs, "chr20_DSS_DMCs.RDS")

nrow(dss_dmcs)
[1] 8188
# ============================================================
# Wilcoxon DMC calling
# ============================================================

# Extract methylation proportions
meth_matrix <- getMeth(BS_filtered, type = "raw")

# Extract chromosome and position information
bs_chr <- as.character(seqnames(BS_filtered))
bs_pos <- start(BS_filtered)

# Keep only selected samples
meth_matrix <- meth_matrix[, selected_samples, drop = FALSE]

# Create Wilcoxon result table
wilcox_results <- data.table(
  chr = bs_chr,
  pos = bs_pos,
  cpg_id = paste(bs_chr, bs_pos, sep = "_")
)

# Calculate group means
wilcox_results[, mean_healthy := rowMeans(
  meth_matrix[, group1_samples, drop = FALSE],
  na.rm = TRUE
)]

wilcox_results[, mean_tumor := rowMeans(
  meth_matrix[, group2_samples, drop = FALSE],
  na.rm = TRUE
)]

# Effect size in same direction as DSS:
# diff = healthy - tumor
wilcox_results[, diff := mean_healthy - mean_tumor]

# CpG-wise Wilcoxon test
wilcox_results[, pvalue := apply(
  meth_matrix,
  1,
  function(x) {
    healthy_vals <- as.numeric(x[group1_samples])
    tumor_vals <- as.numeric(x[group2_samples])

    if (sum(!is.na(healthy_vals)) < 2 || sum(!is.na(tumor_vals)) < 2) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }

    if (length(unique(c(healthy_vals, tumor_vals))) < 2) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }

    test <- tryCatch(
      wilcox.test(
        healthy_vals,
        tumor_vals,
        exact = FALSE
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (is.null(test)) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }

    test$p.value
  }
)]

# Adjust p-values
wilcox_results[, fdr := p.adjust(pvalue, method = "BH")]

# Call Wilcoxon DMCs
wilcox_dmcs <- wilcox_results[
  fdr < fdr_cutoff & abs(diff) >= delta_cutoff
]

wilcox_dmcs[, method := "Wilcoxon"]

# Save Wilcoxon DMCs
fwrite(wilcox_dmcs, "chr20_Wilcoxon_DMCs.csv")
saveRDS(wilcox_dmcs, "chr20_Wilcoxon_DMCs.RDS")

nrow(wilcox_dmcs)
[1] 0
# ============================================================
# Wilcoxon DMCs using nominal p-value instead of FDR
# Use this because FDR-adjusted Wilcoxon gives 0 DMCs
# ============================================================

wilcox_dmcs <- wilcox_results[
  pvalue < 0.05 & abs(diff) >= delta_cutoff
]

wilcox_dmcs[, method := "Wilcoxon_nominal_p"]

nrow(wilcox_dmcs)
[1] 0
fwrite(wilcox_dmcs, "chr20_Wilcoxon_DMCs_nominal_p.csv")
saveRDS(wilcox_dmcs, "chr20_Wilcoxon_DMCs_nominal_p.RDS")

# Venn diagram: DSS vs Wilcoxon nominal p-value
# ============================================================
library(ggvenn)

  ),
  Hypomethylated_in_tumor = c(
    sum(dss_dmcs$diff > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(wilcox_dmcs$diff > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)

Threshold exploration. Test 4 combinations: ○ p<0.05, Δβ>0.1 ○ p<0.01, Δβ>0.1 ○ p<0.05, Δβ>0.2 ○ p<0.01, Δβ>0.2 Create a comparison table. Plot: number of DMCs vs threshold stringency. Recommend best threshold for your data

# Test 4 threshold combinations
threshold_grid <- data.table(
  p_threshold = c(0.05, 0.01, 0.05, 0.01),
  delta = c(0.1, 0.1, 0.2, 0.2)
)

threshold_results <- list()

for (i in 1:nrow(threshold_grid)) {
  
  p_cut <- threshold_grid$p_threshold[i]
  d_cut <- threshold_grid$delta[i]
  
  dmcs_tmp <- callDML(
    dmlTest,
    p.threshold = p_cut,
    delta = d_cut
  )
  
  dmcs_tmp <- as.data.table(dmcs_tmp)
  
  threshold_results[[i]] <- data.table(
    threshold = paste0("p<", p_cut, ", Δβ>", d_cut),
    p_threshold = p_cut,
    delta = d_cut,
    total_DMCs = nrow(dmcs_tmp),
    hypermethylated = sum(dmcs_tmp$diff > 0),
    hypomethylated = sum(dmcs_tmp$diff < 0)
  )
}

threshold_summary <- rbindlist(threshold_results)

threshold_summary[, stringency_order := 1:.N]

Create a volcano plot for DMCs. Explain the relationship between methylation difference and statistical significance.

volcano_data <- copy(dmcs_final)

# Add direction if not already present
volcano_data[, direction := ifelse(
  diff > 0,
  "Hypermethylated",
  "Hypomethylated"
)]

# Avoid Inf values if any FDR values are 0
volcano_data[fdr == 0, fdr := min(volcano_data[fdr > 0]$fdr, na.rm = TRUE)]

# Calculate -log10(FDR)
volcano_data[, neg_log_fdr := -log10(fdr)]

# Volcano plot
ggplot(volcano_data, aes(x = diff, y = neg_log_fdr, color = direction)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Hypermethylated" = "#E64B35",
      "Hypomethylated" = "#4DBBD5"
    )
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(-0.1, 0.1),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(0.05),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Volcano Plot - DMCs",
    x = "Methylation Difference (Δβ, Tumor - Normal)",
    y = "-log10(FDR)",
    color = "Direction"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top"
  )

Create an MA plot (or equivalent): ○ x-axis: average methylation level, ○ y-axis: methylation difference. Explain what happens at low coverage / extreme methylation levels.

# Define sample groups
normal_samples <- c("SRR11647652", "SRR11647653")
tumor_samples  <- c("SRR11647662", "SRR11647663")

# Get methylation matrix from BS_filtered
meth_mat <- getMeth(BS_filtered, type = "raw", what = "perBase")
meth_mat <- as.data.table(meth_mat)

# Add CpG coordinates
meth_mat[, chr := as.character(seqnames(BS_filtered))]
meth_mat[, pos := start(BS_filtered)]

# Calculate average methylation in each group
meth_mat[, normal_mean := rowMeans(.SD, na.rm = TRUE), .SDcols = normal_samples]
meth_mat[, tumor_mean := rowMeans(.SD, na.rm = TRUE), .SDcols = tumor_samples]

# Average methylation across both groups
meth_mat[, avg_methylation := rowMeans(.SD, na.rm = TRUE), .SDcols = c("normal_mean", "tumor_mean")]

# Methylation difference: tumor - normal
meth_mat[, diff := tumor_mean - normal_mean]

# Keep only significant DMCs if using dmcs_dt
dmcs_ids <- paste(dmcs_dt$chr, dmcs_dt$pos, sep = ":")

meth_mat[, cpg_id := paste(chr, pos, sep = ":")]
meth_mat[, significant := ifelse(cpg_id %in% dmcs_ids, "Significant DMC", "Not significant")]

# MA plot
ggplot(meth_mat, aes(x = avg_methylation, y = diff, color = significant)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Significant DMC" = "#E64B35",
      "Not significant" = "grey70"
    )
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-0.1, 0.1), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "black") +
  labs(
    title = "MA Plot of Differential Methylation",
    x = "Average methylation level",
    y = "Methylation difference (Δβ, Tumor - Normal)",
    color = ""
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top"
  )
